psychological_meaning: County Green evokes feelings of nature, growth, and tranquility. It is associated with stability, endurance, and harmony. The color is often linked to prosperity and new beginnings, suggesting a sense of balance and well-being. It is perceived as a calming and reassuring color, promoting feelings of security and connection to the earth.
